stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
I’m deeply saddened by the death of Barre Mayor Thom Lauzon.

He was a man of soaring talent and integrity, capable of being successful anywhere. He chose his beloved Barre for where he and the partner he adored, Karen, would be generous giants of community life. He loved the people of Barre, and he was always there to help, nothing pleased him more than helping a neighbor.

My thoughts are with Thom’s loved ones and the entire Barre community.

On Veterans Day, we thank our servicemembers and their families for the many ways they put our country’s needs ahead of their own.

Today and every day, we must work together to strengthen the resources that support this brave and selfless community.
https://t.co/AC90gDrNOc

Winter storms in Gaza flooded 70,000 tents this past weekend and it’s getting colder. They need tents, tarps, blankets, cooking gas, and health services.

Palestinians are still living in the aftermath of the Israeli government’s blockade. https://t.co/7WcMx0gDFR
We must stop funding President Trump’s forever war with Iran.

When Democrats take control of Congress in January, we must immediately work to:

—Lower the cost of living.
—Restore health care.
—Stop the war with Iran.
—End President Trump’s trade war.

President Trump learned nothing from the elections.
 
Stephen Miller is the reason ICE has turned into a masked secret police force pulling people off the street.
 
He should be fired, not promoted.

Harmeet Dhillon took control of the Civil Rights Division—formed to protect the most vulnerable people in America—and used the significant might and resources of the office to attack the very same people.

She shouldn’t have been confirmed in the first place. https://t.co/zEl4bVpieB

topics.topic: Civil Rights and Liberties, Minority Issues

posts.text:
This is yet another instance of what looks like a pay-to-play scheme for a rich individual trying to secure a pardon from President Trump.

And as usual, Trump doesn't even care about the potential corruption inside his Administration. He just wants to make sure he gets his cut. https://t.co/sOb7UTfU9Q
This is why we can’t get rid of the Education Department. https://t.co/N6JGyfMmSY https://t.co/79FUpmwcy7

States already spend millions and devote immense resources to recover after disasters, but they can’t do it alone. Disasters will only continue to hurt our communities, and the federal government needs to be there to help.

We need to work across the aisle to reform FEMA, not destroy it.

New technology is helping our nation's manufacturing industry become safer and more efficient.

I joined the Vermont Biz2Biz Expo in South Burlington to discuss how small and mid-sized manufacturers can harness tech and thrive in Vermont. https://t.co/EF65DnVt1O

With Big Pharma charging insanely high prices to Americans for prescription drugs, many choose to import prescription drugs from licensed pharmacies in countries with lower prices like Canada.

But the Trump Administration is attempting to end mail order importation of prescription drugs. I joined Senator Klobuchar to send a letter to the Administration, urging them to drop the change. I’m glad they’ve postponed enforcement of the rule, but we need to change this outdated policy.

Americans are paying too much for medications they rely on. We should be making things easier, not harder for them.

The Trump Administration is attempting to cut staff and services from Head Start, which supports our kids and their families.   

I visited the Head Start center in Rutland to hear how this could hurt Vermont and share how I’m fighting against it. https://t.co/GBDjw6Py0y
Why have 1 in 12 rural hospitals closed in the past 15 years? https://t.co/lQpJzPkzy6

Three years ago, Vermonter and journalist Dylan Collins was attacked and wounded by the Israel Defense Forces despite being clearly marked as press.

Dylan and every other journalist attacked or killed by the IDF deserve justice.

We must protect freedom of the press and defend the safety of journalists.

On Indigenous Peoples' Day, we celebrate their contributions to our society.

We must recommit also ourselves to reckoning with past harms so we create a stronger future together.

NEW: Many of the things you buy every day would’ve been cheaper this year if it wasn’t for President Trump’s tariffs.

He’s making a choice to cost you money with his trade war. https://t.co/DdAPj8R0mY
https://t.co/65Hsysrzpy

The White River National Fish Hatchery has been reviving native fish species in Vermont and New York for decades. But now the Trump Administration wants to shutter it.
 
I’m leading a letter to protect the work that's healing our ecosystem and boosting tourism revenue.

The Trump Administration is slashing fuel efficiency standards for cars.

It means you’ll pay thousands more at the pump over the lifetime of your car, especially as Trump’s illegal war with Iran drives gas prices even higher. https://t.co/8CYKE32v5C

It’s been three years since Israel was shaken by a horrifying terror attack by Hamas that resulted in the brutal assault, torture, and killing of over 1,400 civilians, as well as hundreds being held hostage.

Today, I’m thinking of the victims, their families, and those around the world devastated by that dark day.

Starting in a few weeks, the Trump Administration is devastating the REAP program, which provides grants for renewable energy projects to farmers and small businesses.

Farmers are getting crushed by high oil prices right now. This is a program that helps save farmers money at a time when thousands of small farms are closing every year.

President Trump is making it harder and harder for farms to survive.
What’s the Trump corruption of the day? Take a watch. https://t.co/YoLXttmqpT

I’m very excited that two of my bills were passed out of the Senate as part of an IRS reform package.

The Unlocking Low-Income Taxpayer Clinic Funding Act would make it easier for clinics that provide free or low-cost tax services for disputes with the IRS to get federal funding.

The Protecting Innocent Taxpayers from Endless Assessments Act would protect victims of tax preparer fraud.

I’m going to keep working across the aisle to get these passed into law.
https://t.co/CSYjpjngR7

Update: A federal judge has blocked the Trump Administration’s attempts to withhold counterterrorism funding from states unless they share voter data, including disclosing sensitive information.

@SenatorAndyKim and I wrote to the Administration in August, demanding they withdraw these threats to public safety funding.

I’m heading to Brattleboro on Monday for the next stop of my Common Grounds Listening Session tour. 

I hope you join me for coffee and share how I can help you in Congress. https://t.co/8jdeCHLZEV https://t.co/zgzwRMNHTE
92% of the people in Gaza have only a canvas tent or a plastic sheet for shelter. https://t.co/VnrGfgcFUy

I joined my colleagues in forcing a vote on a resolution ordering the Trump Administration to report on the killings of Americans in the West Bank and the failure to bring perpetrators to justice. https://t.co/ENbNyDLHlZ

The Trump Administration has rolled back a Biden-era rule that added sexual orientation and gender identity protections for students.

It’s a disgusting attack on the civil rights of students who want to safely learn like everyone else.

posts.text: President Trump’s tariffs are costing Vermonters money. I have the numbers. https://t.co/kHb4N1Czka

I’m very pleased that two Vermont projects I secured funding for have received the money to move forward.

Northeastern Vermont Regional Hospital received $1.4 million to construct new pharmacies in Caledonia County. Since the closure of pharmacies in Johnson and Hardwick, folks have had to drive further to fill their prescriptions. This will create more options close to home.

UVM Health Network received $694,000 to make safety improvements for health care workers in their facilities. Every time I talk to health care workers in Vermont, they tell me they’re facing more violence at work than ever. It’s unacceptable, and this project will help protect them and patients at the same time.
I spoke on the Senate Floor about American citizens killed, injured, and detained by Israeli security forces. https://t.co/qULpnazdTp

I’m glad AI companies are recognizing the threat their technology poses and admitting they need more safeguards, but we need more than a promise to do better.
 
I have a proposal with @SenatorBennet that would create a new agency to regulate Big Tech and AI, focused on protecting the American people, not profits.

A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.
financial_disclosures.note: Senate financial disclosures are filed through efd.senate.gov, a different system from the House Clerk index used here. Senate filings are not listed yet.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
